description: US counties and county equivalents — all 3,235 of them — with their Census and USPS names, which disagree for over a hundred, plus ANSI code, legal type, land and water area, and USPS delivery footprint. Filter by state to get every county in that state: without a filter only the first 25 are returned, and they are FIPS-ordered, so an unfiltered call answers with Alabama rather than with whatever was asked about. Costs nothing and needs no key.

limit.description: Cap the number of counties returned. Defaults to 25 when no state is given, or to all of them when one is.

state.description: Two-letter US state or territory code. Returns EVERY county in that state, so no limit is needed — Texas is the largest at 254. Omit to browse all states.
